mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in CPIAUCSL (inflation) triggers Fed rate hikes, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 1% over the next month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite CPIAUCSL rising >1%, or the inflation rise is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Rising FEDFUNDS signals tighter monetary policy, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 0.10 in the next month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 0.10, or the rise is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDPC1 (GDP growth) signals stronger corporate demand, boosting earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 growth, or the growth reverses.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in HOUST (housing starts) above 1,500 units signals increased housing demand, boosting construction sector activity and corporate profits, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST crosses above 1500 units in the next month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite HOUST crossing above 1500, or the surge is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in INDPRO (industrial production) reduces inflationary pressures, prompting central banks to ease policy and supporting equity valuations for positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained INDPRO growth, or the growth reverses.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in UNRATE below 5.5% signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 5.5%, or the decline is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in UNRATE above 6.0% triggers fears of an overheating labor market, reducing growth expectations and causing investors to flee to safer assets, resulting in negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 6.0% in the next week
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE crossing above 6.0%, or the spike is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL creates conflicting signals; however, the combined effect of higher discount rates and inflation expectations suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rising, or the individual effects cancel out without the combined impact.
